'''Crusader armors''' were models of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] developed by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==History==
{{Quote|Conveniently, as these things happen; we've made one for the Rebel Alliance and one for the Empire. Of course, we took precautions&hellip; so that each wouldn't know what we're developing for the other side.|Anonymous Black Sun member|<ref name="INMW" />}}
[[File:CrusaderMarkIIIRestuss.jpg|thumb|left|220px|An Imperial wearing Crusader Mark III armor during the Battle of Restuss.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the members of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] realized that thanks to their fruitful collaboration with the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a unique business opportunity presented itself. Due to advances in their armor forges working on Mandalorian technology within the [[Death Watch bunker|Death Watch Bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the Black Sun realized it could create and distribute different types of battle armor to both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="INMW" />

[[File:CrusaderMarkIIRestuss2.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Rebel troops wearing Crusader Mark II armors on Restuss.]]
Two different versions of this armor were created, the [[Crusader Mark II armor|Mark II]] series for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and the [[Crusader Mark III armor|Mark III]] series for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Deliberately, the Black Sun development team made sure each armor appeared distinctly different, so that neither the Empire nor the Rebellion would know that they were being armored from the same source. This subterfuge allowed for both sides to unknowingly support the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and increase the group's freedom while the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] raged. Each armor series was priced equally, resulting in similar protective characteristics.<ref name="INMW" />

Crusader armors were introduced around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> and were first seen in action on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Battle of Restuss]]. The armors were worn by several Alliance and Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] as well as elite troops such as [[Rebel elite commando/Legends|Rebel Elite Commandos]]. In addition, factionally aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who received battlefield [[commendation]]s were able to trade their awards for items such as this armor from respective Rebel and Imperial [[commendation officer]].<ref name="SWG:TBoR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|The Battle of Restuss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Crusader armors appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBoR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Crusader armors were added to the game along with the "[[W:c:swg:Restuss|Battle of Restuss]]" [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|PvP]] battlefield,<ref name="SWG:TBoR" /> introduced in the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1.1|Chapter 1.1]]" released on [[June 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

As part of the Battle of Restuss story arc, players might receive commendation items for assisting their chosen faction during the battle, which could be stacked and traded for various items such as this armor, from Commendation Officer [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]].<ref name="SWG:TBoR" />
